blocks.packageReason: Tier B + package. Users (1): Celestial Jelly (6078) attr 0 (its only attr). The 0.25 was a literal in apply; it is now constructor argument 0 (a fraction, default 0.25) shown to staff as a percent through a codec. Package, reason: no library effect leaves a Pokemon at X% HP in place of a knockout, and the class pushes its once-per-battle memory (battleData.erAbilityProvenance, key celestial-jelly:spent) and cures status in the same apply, in a fixed order, so splitting it in the declaration would re-implement it; requested as effect.survive-lethal-hit plus the memory in time.once-per. The gate cannot be bound yet: field.weather reads arena.weatherType (not suppression aware) and field.terrain reads arena.terrainType (hidden by Clueless), while the class reads the raw terrain and asks weather.isEffectSuppressed(); requests R-B14-3.2 and R-B14-3.3. Oddities, not fixed: (1) the cure is resetStatus, which refuses to cure an Amaterasu burn; (2) Heavy Rain counts as Rain here; (3) the flyout is shown by the engine around apply, and the preview rewrites the damage without remembering anything; (4) SUSPECTED BUG: the gate reads `weather !== null` and then `weather.isEffectSuppressed()`, but a fresh arena holds `undefined` (a weather that was set and cleared holds `null`), so on a lethal hit with no weather ever set the gate throws a TypeError inside the damage calculation (seen in a battle, and pinned in B14/chunk3.test.ts); `weather != null` would be the fix.

blocks.packageReason: The 10% step is a constructor argument (default 0.1) and an editable param. The marker name perpetual-motion is deliberately NOT a param: it is the shared key that ties this attr to the follow-up move and to four other attrs of the same ability (three of them in B17); changing it on this attr alone would silently switch the bonus off, and the gate is the editable slot for the condition. Package, reason: the multiplier is `1 + streak x 0.1` where the streak is a per-Pokemon counter written by PerpetualMotionProgressAbAttr; effect.multiply-power only takes a fixed number (a counter-based power effect is requested). Users (1): Perpetual Motion (6022) attr 4 of 5. Gate is legacy-closure pending move.scripted-marker. The armed-state check stays a non-editable guard clause in the class (it is state of the ability's own machine, listed under feasibility, not a registered guard). Oddities, not fixed: canApply does not call super.canApply, so skipDuringMovesetGen is ignored (it is false for this class, so no effect); the class applies on simulated power previews too, which is correct for damage previews.

blocks.packageReason: Package, reason: the effect is one step of a counter state machine (pending flag and streak) shared with PerpetualMotionTriggerAbAttr, PerpetualMotionPostTurnAbAttr, PerpetualMotionResolutionAbAttr (B17) and PerpetualMotionPowerAbAttr; the library has no counter effect (requested). Users (1): Perpetual Motion (6022) attr 3 of 5. Gate is legacy-closure pending the request move.scripted-marker. Oddities, not fixed: the inherited attackCondition (`move.category !== STATUS`, constructor argument 0) is not exposed as its own slot; for this user it is always the default, and the gate re-states it as move.damaging. The streak is stored on summonData, so it resets when the Pokemon leaves the field.
